title: AI for Americans First: US AI Protectionism, Recomposition of the Global Technological Order, and Consequences for France and Europe (2026-2030)
description: Integrated geostrategic and economic study of US AI protectionism under the Trump 2.0 administration, crossing energy, semiconductors, compute and regulation. Construction of the Compute-Adjusted Competitiveness Index (CACI) quantifying a structural US/EU competitive advantage of 7 to 12 to 1 over the 2026-2030 period. Multilingual support (EN/FR/PT).
